rate_basis: Monthly average rate of the posting period
rationale: P&L items are earned evenly across the month, so each month is translated at its own average rate and year-to-date figures are the sum of translated months. Applying an annual or year-to-date average to a cumulative balance is the single most common FX error in hand-built consolidations and produces a different answer.
exception_handling: A missing monthly average rate is a blocking error. The period does not close.

rate_basis: Closing spot rate at the last calendar day of the period
rationale: Current-rate method: all assets and liabilities of a foreign operation are translated at the closing rate, with the difference taken to CTA.
exception_handling: A missing closing rate is a blocking error.

rate_basis: Rate on the date of the originating transaction
rationale: Share capital, additional paid-in capital and pre-acquisition reserves are frozen at the rate ruling when the capital was contributed or the subsidiary acquired. Retranslating them at closing rates would eliminate the CTA that the method is designed to isolate.
exception_handling: Historical rates are held in fx_rate_historical keyed on entity, account and event date. A missing historical rate blocks the period.

rate_basis: Opening balance carried forward in USD
rationale: Opening retained earnings in USD equals the prior period's closing USD balance. It is never retranslated. The current-year result is added at the P&L average rates already used, which is what makes the CTA an arithmetic residual rather than a plug.
exception_handling: Prior period must be closed and locked before the current period translates.

rate_basis: Sum of monthly translated P&L
rationale: The current-year equity result must equal the USD P&L translated at monthly average rates. Any difference indicates a translation defect rather than a business event.
exception_handling: Tested by CTL-FX-03; a variance above USD 1 is blocking.

rate_basis: Computed residual for the period
rationale: The period CTA movement is the arithmetic difference between assets and liabilities translated at closing rates and equity translated at historical and derived rates. It is an output of the translation engine, never an input and never a plug entered by hand.
exception_handling: Tested against an independent expected-CTA calculation (opening net assets x rate movement, plus current-year result x (closing less average)). Variance above 0.5% of the movement is a warning; above 2% is blocking. See CTL-FX-04.

rate_basis: Prior period closing USD balance
rationale: NCI opening balance carries forward at its prior closing USD value and is never retranslated, exactly as retained earnings does. Retranslating it would create a second, uncontrolled source of translation difference in equity.
exception_handling: Prior period must be closed and locked. See CTL-CON-11.

rate_basis: Not translated
rationale: Headcount, hours, units and square footage are not monetary. Translating them would be meaningless and would corrupt per-FTE metrics.
exception_handling: Statistical accounts carry a null USD amount and are reported in their native unit only.

rate_basis: Locked budget rate set
rationale: The budget is translated at the rates locked at approval and is never restated. Restating a budget for later FX movements destroys accountability -- managers would be measured against a target that moved after they agreed it.
exception_handling: Budget rate set is immutable once the version is locked. Changing it requires a new version.

rate_basis: Actual rates for closed months plus forward rates for open months
rationale: A rolling forecast must use actual rates where months are closed, otherwise the forecast disagrees with actuals it contains.
exception_handling: Forward rates are stamped into the forecast version at issue and frozen for that version.

rate_basis: Actual local amounts retranslated at budget rates
rationale: Isolates the translation effect so that operational performance can be assessed without FX noise. FX impact equals reported USD less constant-currency USD.
exception_handling: Stored as a third amount column on the fact rather than computed at query time. See ADR-0005.

rate_basis: Closing spot rate
rationale: Both sides of an intercompany balance are translated at the same closing rate, so a pair denominated in a single currency eliminates exactly. Where the two entities record the balance in different currencies, a residual arises that must be posted to FX gain/loss and not left in the elimination.
exception_handling: Any residual above USD 1 after elimination is investigated by CTL-IC-03 before it is written off.

rate_basis: Monthly average rate
rationale: Seller income and buyer expense are translated at the same monthly average rate so that the elimination nets to nil in USD as well as in local currency.
exception_handling: If the two sides were recorded in different months, the timing difference is a genuine cut-off issue and is reported by CTL-IC-02, not absorbed.

rate_basis: Closing spot rate
rationale: Closing rate as for all balance sheet items.
exception_handling: The movement on foreign-currency cash is presented as 'effect of exchange rate changes on cash' in the cash flow statement rather than inside operating activities.

rate_basis: USD per one unit of foreign currency
rationale: Every rate in the platform is stored as the USD value of one unit of the foreign currency, so translation is always a multiplication. Mixed quotation conventions (some direct, some indirect) are a recurring source of inverted-rate errors.
exception_handling: Rates are validated on load: a CAD rate outside 0.60-0.90, a GBP rate outside 1.00-1.60 or a EUR rate outside 0.90-1.35 is rejected as a probable inversion. See CTL-FX-05.

rate_basis: Spot rate on the consolidation effective date
rationale: The acquired entity's opening balance sheet is translated at the spot rate on the acquisition date. That translated equity becomes the frozen historical base for FX-P03 and the starting point for the entity's CTA. Goodwill and purchase-price-allocation intangibles are treated as assets OF THE FOREIGN OPERATION and therefore translate at closing rates thereafter, generating CTA - not as parent-currency assets held flat.
exception_handling: A missing acquisition-date rate blocks consolidation of that entity. Halden Valve: 2023-04-01 EUR. Vector Systems B.V.: 2024-07-01 EUR. See CTL-FX-10.

rate_basis: Prior period closing CTA in USD
rationale: CTA opening equals the prior period's closing CTA. It is never retranslated and never recalculated. For an entity's first period in the group it is nil by definition, because the acquisition-date translation (FX-P16) sets the historical base.
exception_handling: Prior period must be closed and locked. Tested by CTL-FX-09.

rate_basis: Opening plus movement plus recycling
rationale: Closing CTA = 330100 opening + 330200 movement + 330300 recycled on disposal. This is a derived financial statement caption, not a posted account. The roll-forward must be complete and continuous: closing CTA of one period is the opening CTA of the next, with no unexplained step.
exception_handling: Tested by CTL-FX-09 at entity and group level.

rate_basis: Rate history of the disposed operation
rationale: On disposal of a foreign operation the accumulated CTA relating to that operation is recycled from equity to the income statement. NO DISPOSALS ARE IN SCOPE (ADR-0009), so this account exists and is policy-defined but carries nil in every modelled period. It is specified now so that a future disposal is a data event rather than a redesign.
exception_handling: Account must be nil in all periods while no disposal exists. Tested by CTL-FX-09.

rate_basis: NCI percentage of the entity CTA movement
rationale: The CTA movement of a partially owned foreign subsidiary is split between group equity (330200) and non-controlling interests (340400) in proportion to ownership at the period end. Allocating 100% of a subsidiary CTA movement to group equity is a common and material error - it overstates group equity and understates NCI. Applies to NIG-510 only (20%).
exception_handling: Ownership percentage comes from ownership_history.csv effective for the period. Tested by CTL-CON-11 and CTL-FX-09.

rate_basis: Result at monthly average, dividends at the rate on the declaration date
rationale: The NCI share of the result translates at the same monthly average rates as the subsidiary P&L it derives from, so that the P&L allocation (850100) and the equity credit (340200) agree in USD. Dividends translate at the rate ruling when declared and are not retranslated.
exception_handling: Tested by CTL-FS-09 and CTL-CON-11.

rate_basis: Split between cash and non-cash effects
rationale: The FX effect is presented in TWO places and they must not be conflated. (1) Translation movement on foreign-currency CASH balances is presented as 'effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents', outside operating, investing and financing. (2) Translation movement on all other foreign-currency working capital and non-cash balances is a non-cash reconciling item WITHIN operating activities. Routing the whole CTA movement through the cash line produces an implausible FX effect on cash and was a defect corrected in Phase 1.
exception_handling: The two components must sum to the total non-CTA-equity translation effect. Tested by CTL-FS-03 and CTL-FX-11.
